Fidelity has filed an S-1 registration statement with the SEC to launch a spot Chainlink ETF, expected to trade on Nasdaq under the ticker FLNK. The fund would hold LINK directly and track its price without staking or distributing staking rewards. Anchorage Digital Bank, BitGo and Coinbase Custody would serve as custodians, with share creations and redemptions available in LINK or cash.

Grayscale and Bitwise already offer spot Chainlink ETFs in the U.S., with approximately $112 million and $42 million in assets under management, respectively, as of November 24. — link

Binance Wallet Launches Real Graded Card Gacha Packs with Physical Card NFT Certificates

Binance Wallet has integrated Renaiss Protocol to launch Gacha, allowing users to purchase packs with USDT and reveal real, professionally authenticated and graded trading cards. The physical cards are held in custody, while ownership is represented by NFTs on BNB Smart Chain. Card pools, rarity odds, and rules are disclosed, with results generated using a verifiable random function (VRF). Users can sell cards back at quoted prices within 72 hours, after which unsold cards are transferred to their Binance Wallets as NFTs. Physical redemption is not yet available but is planned for a future release. — link
